_**User**_

Verify this issue exists and fix it:

The `resolveCompiledPath` function builds a candidates list by first pushing `${outfile}.exe` if the outfile doesn't end with .exe (lines 33-34), then unshifting the same `${outfile}.exe` to the front if it's a Windows target or Windows host (lines 38-39). Since both operations check `!outfile.endsWith(".exe")`, when this condition is true on both branches, `.exe` gets added twice to the candidates array. This creates redundant path checks that don't affect correctness but waste iterations in the search loop.
